title: React State Management & Data Fetching — Revision

sections.title: Mental model
sections.body:
Pick by **scope**:

- **Local** — `useState` / `useReducer`.
- **Cross-component** — context (sparingly) or Zustand / Jotai.
- **Server state** — TanStack Query / SWR / RTK Query.
- **Global app** — Redux Toolkit (still fine!), MobX (less common).

**Server state ≠ client state**. The biggest junior mistake is jamming server data into Redux.

sections.title: Must-know concepts
sections.body:

- **Context api patterns** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Redux fundamentals** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.

sections.title: Likely interview hooks
sections.body:
- **Context re-renders** every consumer on any change — split contexts or memoise.
- **Cache invalidation** — TanStack Query gives it for free; rolling your own is a trap.
- **Optimistic updates** — TanStack Query / RTK Query both support; handle rollback.
- **Forms** — React Hook Form is the modern default for performant uncontrolled-style forms.
- **Selector pattern** — pick slices to avoid unnecessary re-renders.

sections.title: Speaking template
sections.body: > *"Server state goes in TanStack Query for the cache + invalidation story; client UI state lives in component-local hooks or a small Zustand store; cross-cutting concerns (theme, auth) in context with selectors. I avoid Redux unless we already have it."*
